<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Base Allocation Hub">89f4318683018f5027aba6d0deaad3bc</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:c9a7f5ca83018f5027aba6d0deaad368</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Capacity on Portal</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading, isTemplate) {
    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    // Chama o Script Include passando a Base selecionada
    var ga = new GlideAjax('BasePortalValidation');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'checkBaseCapacity');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_base_id', newValue);
    
    // getXMLAnswer roda em segundo plano sem travar ou congelar a tela do portal
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(response) {
        if (response === "false") {
            // Exibe a mensagem de erro estilizada logo abaixo do campo no Portal
            g_form.showFieldMsg('base', 'Esta base já atingiu a lotação máxima permitida.', 'error');
            
            // Limpa a variável para o usuário não conseguir submeter o formulário
            g_form.setValue('base', '');
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-26 17:50:12</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>cef1a21a8305039027aba6d0deaad32c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Capacity on Portal</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Base Allocation Hub" source="x_1902784_base_a_0">383e980a83454f5027aba6d0deaad3a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Base Allocation Hub">383e980a83454f5027aba6d0deaad3a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_cef1a21a8305039027aba6d0deaad32c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-26 17:50:12</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
